reason: I already take Toplux and just reorder it when it runs out, and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. $25 to $30 a month is real money on my budget, and I'm not switching for one form of magnesium.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put 8 forms in one capsule? Plus it's made in China and I've never heard of this brand.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower price, around $12 to $15 for 30 days, or a free trial sachet that proves it works better than what I already take.
